text: At sunset, half a kilometre down, something starts to climb.
asr: At sunset, half a kilometer down, something starts to climb.

text: A lanternfish, no longer than your finger.
asr: A lantern fish no longer than your finger.

text: It climbs toward the surface, in the dark.
But the faint light from above turns it into a shadow.
And hunters below are looking up.
So it turns on the lights along its belly,
as bright as the glow above. The shadow is gone.
By midnight, it reaches the surface to feed.
Every night, countless animals rise from the deep.
It is the largest migration on Earth.
Before sunrise, they all sink back into the dark.
